catalogRoute.title: List datasets
catalogRoute.summary: Reject unsupported query parameters, then request an authorized catalog payload.
talk: Reject unsupported query parameters, then request an authorized catalog payload.

catalog.title: Authorize catalog access
catalog.summary: Resolve the role, select permitted datasets, authorize their grains, then read publication metadata.
talk: Resolve the role, select permitted datasets, authorize their grains, then read publication metadata.

payload.title: Build catalog payload
payload.summary: Encode the public schema, supported filters and coverage. No publication produces unavailable status.
talk: Encode the public schema, supported filters and coverage. No publication produces unavailable status.

route.title: Preview endpoint
route.summary: Translate query parameters and call PreviewService.page.
talk: Translate query parameters and call PreviewService.page.

page.title: Orchestrate a preview
page.summary: Authorize before publication/files, validate filters, reserve execution and return bounded complete rows.
talk: This checkout keeps initial reads, continuation, response encoding and cleanup in one method. Use Full source to see their relationship.

access.title: Authorize the selected grain
access.summary: Fresh role checks apply to first reads and continuation requests.
talk: Fresh role checks apply to first reads and continuation requests.

reserve.title: Reserve execution capacity
reserve.summary: Acquire the bounded analytical slot before initial publication lookup or file downloads.
talk: Acquire the bounded analytical slot before initial publication lookup or file downloads.

forward.title: Delegate to the active runtime
forward.summary: The supervisor forwards the application execution port to the currently active launcher.
talk: The supervisor forwards the application execution port to the currently active launcher.

active.title: Select a generation
active.summary: Read exact published resource descriptors from PostgreSQL.
talk: Read exact published resource descriptors from PostgreSQL.

prepare.title: Verify and pin inputs
prepare.summary: Prepare the selected resource with admission limits and verified cached/staged files.
talk: Prepare the selected resource with admission limits and verified cached/staged files.

load.title: Load a resource on cache miss
load.summary: Inspect durable resource readback, physical verification and coverage before exposing a pinned file.
talk: Inspect durable resource readback, physical verification and coverage before exposing a pinned file.

create.title: Keep the preview snapshot
create.summary: Bind owner, filters, page size and pinned generation to an expiring sequence.
talk: Bind owner, filters, page size and pinned generation to an expiring sequence.

acquire.title: Acquire a continuation
acquire.summary: Validate the cursor and owner/dataset, then acquire the existing sequence.
talk: Continuation accepts only the cursor. Original filters, page size and generation are preserved.

run.title: Cross the execution boundary
run.summary: Use the reserved runtime to execute a bounded preview with approved inputs.
talk: Use the reserved runtime to execute a bounded preview with approved inputs.

scan.title: Scan the public projection
scan.summary: Apply inclusive date filters and deterministic keyset ordering inside the isolated worker.
talk: Order is period descending, then facility/generator identity ascending where present. One extra row establishes has_more.

views.title: Open exact staged Parquet
views.summary: Construct restricted views over approved files and explicitly project public columns.
talk: Construct restricted views over approved files and explicitly project public columns.

cursor.title: Encode the continuation
cursor.summary: Encode the sequence and last returned key in a signed cursor.
talk: PreviewService.page shrinks whole rows to fit its byte envelope and uses the last included key for next_cursor.

close.title: Confirm worker termination
close.summary: Release runtime capacity only after termination/reaping is confirmed.
talk: Release runtime capacity only after termination/reaping is confirmed.

handoff.title: Retain uncertain ownership
handoff.summary: Transfer leases to supervisor recovery when termination cannot be proved.
talk: Transfer leases to supervisor recovery when termination cannot be proved.

release.title: Release the active reader
release.summary: Release the current read; sequence lifetime and pins are managed separately.
talk: Release the current read; sequence lifetime and pins are managed separately.

discard.title: Discard a failed initial sequence
discard.summary: Retire a failed new sequence without prematurely freeing a live worker’s files.
talk: Retire a failed new sequence without prematurely freeing a live worker’s files.

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.summary: The public dataset definition supplies its grain, columns and schema version.
talk: The public dataset definition supplies its grain, columns and schema version.

read.title: PreviewRead
read.summary: Worker input contains approved files, fixed filters and an optional continuation key.
talk: Worker input contains approved files, fixed filters and an optional continuation key.

rows.title: PreviewRows
rows.summary: Rows and continuation keys must align. Partial data values here illustrate transport structure.
talk: Rows and continuation keys must align. Partial data values here illustrate transport structure.

sequence.title: PreviewSequence
sequence.summary: Ephemeral snapshot metadata owns the prepared inputs across page reads.
talk: Ephemeral snapshot metadata owns the prepared inputs across page reads.

generation.title: Published generation
generation.summary: Exactly three resource descriptors identify the published national, facilities and generators files.
talk: Exactly three resource descriptors identify the published national, facilities and generators files.

flows.title: High-level diagram
flows.lead: The catalog describes what you can read. A preview returns a small page from a verified, fixed data snapshot; later pages keep that same snapshot.
flows.heading: Browse one published version of the data.

lanes.title: Discover available datasets
lanes.caption: Metadata only: this path does not start an analytical worker.

steps.title: Check role and publication
steps.text: Select permitted datasets and read the published generation’s metadata.

steps.title: Show the catalog
steps.text: Return public columns, supported filters and date coverage.

lanes.title: Read the first preview page
lanes.caption: Reserve execution capacity before downloading files. S3 is read only when the verified cache needs it.

steps.title: Choose data and filters
steps.text: Authorize the selected dataset and validate dates, facility and page size.

steps.title: Select a snapshot
steps.text: Reserve capacity and select the current published generation.

steps.title: Prepare verified files
steps.text: Verify and pin the exact resource; keep the snapshot and filters for later pages.

steps.title: Read a small page
steps.text: Scan only approved files and public columns in a stable order.

steps.title: Return rows and cursors
steps.text: Fit complete rows into the response and include the next-page cursor when needed.

lanes.title: Continue with a cursor
lanes.caption: A refresh may publish newer data while this sequence continues reading the original version.

steps.title: Send the cursor
steps.text: Recheck the user’s access; do not accept replacement filters.

steps.title: Recover the same snapshot
steps.text: Validate the cursor and owner, then acquire the pinned files and original filters.

steps.title: Read after the last row
steps.text: Reserve execution and scan the same snapshot using the continuation position.

steps.title: Return the next page
steps.text: Return a fresh cursor or indicate the end of the sequence.

boundaries: Owns sessions, roles and which generation is published.
S3 holds the resource files; the cache verifies and pins the selected inputs.
Expired cursors cannot continue. Failed initial reads discard their sequence; uncertain worker termination keeps inputs protected.
